extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance and troubleshooting for creating a new Wikipedia page, including account requirements, searching for existing content, using the article wizard or draft process, handling redirects/capitalization, and checking deletion logs or database delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only logged-in users who meet the autoconfirmed status can create pages; consider creating an account and waiting until it is autoconfirmed if you plan to start a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create a live article directly, prepare a draft via the article wizard or follow the draft submission/request workflows so experienced editors can review and publish it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Charlie Chaplin The Great Dictator" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a page, search Wikipedia for the topic under different spellings or alternative titles to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check incoming links ('What links here')
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'What links here' tool to discover whether other pages already reference the topic or a redirect, which can indicate existing coverage or the preferred title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created pages may not be visible; try purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect a page was just created but isn't showing, either wait for database propagation or use the purge function to refresh the page view.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify exact capitalization and, if appropriate, create a redirect from the variant title to the correct article to help readers find the content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log and deletion reasons
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you can't find the page because it was deleted, consult the deletion log to learn the reason and whether re-creation or an appeal is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: You can request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you lack privileges or the topic needs community input, follow the appropriate village pump or request-for-deletion/recreation procedures to ask experienced editors to create the page.
